subject.title: Inglewood Unified School District Board, District 1

text: Joyce Randall is a classroom teacher, education advocate, and your elected Trustee for Inglewood Unified School District, Trustee Area 1.

Joyce previously taught biology in Inglewood Unified and continues serving students today as a classroom teacher in Los Angeles Unified. She understands what students, parents, teachers, and school employees need because she has worked directly in public education and remains connected to the classroom.

During Joyce's first term, Inglewood Unified made important progress toward restoring local control after years of state receivership. Joyce has supported responsible oversight, stronger accountability, improved communication with families, and a renewed focus on student achievement.

The next term will be critical. As the district prepares to regain local governance, Trustee Area 1 needs steady, knowledgeable leadership from someone who understands both classroom instruction and the responsibilities of the school board.

Joyce will continue working to strengthen academic achievement, support teachers and staff, improve parent engagement, protect fiscal stability, expand opportunities for students, and ensure that community voices are heard.
Joyce Randall has the experience, commitment, and educational background to help lead Inglewood Unified forward with integrity, independence, and proven dedication.
Please vote again for Joyce Randall for Inglewood Unified School District Trustee, Trustee Area 1.

text: As a lifelong resident of Inglewood and a proud product of the Inglewood Unified School District, I understand firsthand the importance of

a strong public education. I attended Woodworth Elementary, Monroe Junior High, and graduated from Morningside High School before earning a Bachelor of Science in Sociology with a minor in Behavioral Science from California State University, Dominguez Hills.

For more than 15 years, I have dedicated myself to supporting Inglewood students through scholarships, educational programs, and community service. As a Founding Board Member of the Morningside Monarchs Alumni Association, I have helped provide scholarships, recognize student achievement, and expand educational opportunities. I also serve as Speech Chairperson for the Inglewood Black History Celebration, District 4 Planning Commissioner, and Scholarship Board Member for the Century Heights Neighborhood Watch Association.

I am invested in our public schools because I am invested in our families and community. As your School Board Member, I will advocate for fiscal responsibility, academic excellence, safe learning environments, and opportunities that prepare every student for college, careers, and lifelong success.
Together, we can strengthen our schools and build a brighter future for every child.
